title: Cloud NSS feed settings: HTTPS-only URLs and OAuth fields

prose.text: Cloud NSS feeds carry their own endpoint and OAuth settings, validated by the provider. The Go SDK's request handling is in [[shared.sdk-go.request-handling]].

checks.do: Whether a feed's destination and authentication URLs use HTTPS, which the provider validates before calling the API.
Whether OAuth is on and which SIEM types the authentication URL applies to.

cloud-url-cert.statement: In the console, a Cloud NSS feed's API URL is the HTTP/S URL of the SIEM log collection API endpoint. The HTTPS URL must be configured with a publicly trusted SSL certificate, since self-signed or internally issued certificates do not pass the SIEM connectivity test, and OAuth 2.0 Authentication is enabled by default if applicable to the SIEM type.

quotes: API URL: Enter the HTTP/S URL of the SIEM log collection API endpoint.
The HTTPS URL must be configured with a publicly trusted SSL certificate. Self-signed or internally issued certificates do not pass the SIEM connectivity test.
OAuth 2.0 Authentication: This setting is enabled by default if it is applicable to the SIEM type.

https-only-urls.statement: The Terraform provider's Cloud NSS feed resource validates connection_url and authentication_url with validation.IsURLWithHTTPS.

quotes: The HTTPS URL of the SIEM log collection API endpoint

http-url-rejected-before-api.statement: So a Cloud NSS feed whose connection_url or authentication_url is an http URL is rejected by the provider before the API is called.
http-url-rejected-before-api.conditions: Follows from https-only-urls: both attributes take validation.IsURLWithHTTPS as their validator. That Terraform runs a schema attribute's validator while validating the configuration, before a create or update reaches the API, and that IsURLWithHTTPS rejects an http scheme, rest on terraform-plugin-sdk behavior, which no registered source states.

oauth-fields.statement: A Cloud NSS feed has an oauth_authentication switch, and its authentication URL is described as applying when the SIEM type is Azure Sentinel.

quotes: `oauth_authentication` - (Optional) A Boolean value indicating whether OAuth 2.0 authentication is enabled or not
`authentication_url` - (Optional) Authentication URL applicable when SIEM type is set to Azure Sentinel
